name: autoform
description: Turn any AI coding assistant into a Lean 4 formalization agent.

interface.shortDescription: Lean setup, roadmaps, proving, and review
interface.longDescription: AutoForm separates repository setup from source-grounded roadmap construction, keeps the plan as authored Markdown articles, publishes it with GitHub Pages, checks proofs through public Lean MCP servers, and provides distinct visual human-review and rubric-driven agent-review workflows.
defaultPrompt: Set up this Lean repository with an Autoform blueprint, verification CI, and GitHub Pages without planning the mathematics.
Build or refine an Autoform roadmap from my mathematical sources.
Work through the ready nodes in my Autoform blueprint.
Prepare the visual blueprint surfaces so I can review this formalization.
Judge this roadmap or Lean formalization with evidence-based review rubrics.
Audit this formalization corpus or benchmark an Autoform prover.
Develop Autoform itself through its executable formalization example.
